steps.content: Night falls on Northsnow Manor. Heavy snow blankets the roof tiles, and an eerie silence descends upon the land. The strange murder from earlier that day casts a sinister pall over the vast estate.
Amidst the treetops, a slender figure, virtually indistinguishable from the shadows, watches in perfect stillness. Her deep gray eyes survey this wind-whipped, snow-bound "cage" with keen interest.
Snow buries the dead, wind masks the reek of blood... Tsk, this manor's got more secrets than a locked chest.

A <color=#fb9259>secret martial arts codex</color> pops up, causing such a grand commotion, and they don't even send this old granny an invitation? These youngsters today... Where are their manners? Their foresight? Tsk, tsk, tsk.
From the shadows, a girl in light foreign clothing emerges, drifting toward the manor's high walls like a wisp of night mist.
Thud!

An invisible force, thick as a mountain, erupts without warning, slamming into the exact spot where she is about to land. With a muffled grunt, the girl crumples, her slender form flying backward like a kite with a severed string before she lands softly in the snow several yards away.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Well, well... what a watchdog. Vicious thing, aren't you?

She wipes the blood from the corner of her mouth and brushes off her spotless sleeves. On the exposed parts of her arms, eerie purple-blue markings seem to have crept higher. Something beneath her skin writhes restlessly, as if struggling to burst free.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: ...This granny's clock is ticking. Can't be swapping punches with some watchdog. I've got places to be.

The biting cold is irrelevant. She sits down in the snow, commanding the strange stirrings in her body to settle. A frontal assault would be foolish. She has neither the time nor the need for such crudeness.

Then, the girl produces an array of bottles and jars as if from thin air, arranging them neatly before her. The moment she unscrews one, a spine-tingling chorus erupts: a symphony of tiny, skittering sounds.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Shush now, my darlings, shush. Everyone gets a turn. If anything goes wrong, you'll each have your moment to shine.

She pricks her fingertip with a golden needle, and from the wound seeps an eerie, toxic fluid. Several small insects eagerly scramble up the jar's rim, extending their mouthparts to drink this vital sustenance.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Everyone calls me <color=#fb9259>Granny Goldspider</color>. Idiots. They see the gold and think that's all there is. Bless their hearts... if they only knew the variety my little darlings come in.

The girl giggles softly. Once all her little darlings have eaten their fill, she keeps one cradled in her palm. It is a silver-white spider, with limbs streaked in purple-blue and a disturbing, human-like face emblazoned across its back.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: You're up. Go on, take a peek for this old granny. See what heroes have graced this party with their presence. Find me a strong one. Someone... accommodating.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: And that codex, my dear, sniff it out. If those fancy techniques can actually fix this <color=#fb9259>condition</color> of mine, you and your siblings will feast like royalty. Granny promises.

Her cupped hand drifts down, opening gently against the ground. The little spider called Number One blinks once with its gleaming compound eyes, and upon touching the snow, it dissolves instantly into the night.
The little creature moves with nimble precision, scaling the high walls in moments and slipping into the manor. This time, it evades the notice of whatever hidden masters lurk within.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: That's my clever one!

A faint glow emanates from the eerie markings on the girl's body. She closes her eyes, and before her, a different world unfolds. She now views the manor's interior from the low, scuttling perspective of the spider.
[Manor Corridor - Night]

steps.speaker: Spider Number One
steps.content: Doors shut tight, lights out, holding their breath like mice... Think you can fool this granny by playing dead?
The little spider slips into the first guest room, yet when it sees the two people inside, its demeanor shifts to one of disappointment.

steps.speaker: Spider Number One
steps.content: Oh. One of them's actually asleep.

steps.speaker: Spider Number One
steps.content: This little one in gray, scrawny thing... Probably can't handle a nibble. That girl beside...? Tsk, beanpole with no meat.

steps.speaker: Spider Number One
steps.content: Sigh. Gotta find myself one of those martial artists. Sturdy build, and plenty of cunning... moving into a shell like that, now that's what I call comfort.

The tiny spider slips through the crack beneath the door. The two people sleeping soundly inside do not know that their slight frames hold no interest for the creature, and so, unknowingly, they are passed over, escaping a hidden disaster.

steps.speaker: Spider Number One
steps.content: Right then. Two bland dishes, passed. Next course... don't you dare disappoint your granny.
In the darkness, the small spider pauses briefly before crawling, without hesitation, deeper into the estate. It makes its way toward the other guest rooms, drawn by the more complex auras within.
